# Vendor CAD sources

Compiled 2026-11-04 by the CAD Library Engineer, per the DECISIONS.md row of 2026-11-04 ("CAD engineers: use ready 3D models for bought parts").
Downloads were made with curl. No downloaded file was opened or run.
Dimension checks: no CAD kernel was available, so STEP extents come from a rough scan of the CARTESIAN_POINT entries in each file. That scan ignores assembly transforms, so it is reliable for single-body files only. **Re-measure every model when you import it.**
GrabCAD, Onshape, SKF and McMaster need a login or a browser, so for those only the link is recorded.

| Part | URL | Format | Downloaded (path) | Dimensions checked | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Eaglepower LA8308 (KV130, hips) | No model found. Searched GrabCAD and the web. Spec page: https://robu.in/product/eaglepower-la-8308-kv90-motor/ | — | — | — | **Simple placeholder needed:** cylinder Ø92 × 28.5 mm plus a shaft stub. The bolt patterns were not found online. Measure the motor on arrival (O7) before you model the mounting holes. |
| T-Motor MN5008 KV170 (wheel candidate, O9) | Official page with drawing: https://store.tmotor.com/product/mn5008-kv170-motor-antigravity-type.html · drawing image: https://store.tmotor.com/images/202408/161723791516281923.jpg | JPG 2D drawing (no STEP published) | `tmotor_mn5008/MN5008_drawing_tmotor.jpg` | Yes, against the official drawing: Ø55.6 × 32 mm overall, 27 mm without the shaft, base 8.25 mm, shaft stub Ø4 | **Simple placeholder needed**, built from the drawing. **Rotor (prop) side:** 8 × M3, on Ø12 and Ø18 circles (4 + 4 as drawn), Ø4 centre bore. **Stator (base) side:** 4 × M3 on Ø25 (X pattern). Prop adapter: Ø12 with 2 × Ø3.2 holes (Ø5.8 counterbore). Cover: Ø20 × 2.4. 24N28P, 6 mm inner shaft, 696ZZ bearings, 128 g. **Phase resistance: 270 mΩ** (official T-Motor table for KV170; RobotShop agrees). The 720 figure in the same table is **Max. Power (180 s) = 720 W**, so "720 mΩ" is a misreading. The KV340 is 55 mΩ and the KV400 is 50 mΩ. |
